headline: After the ‘Upper Limit Surge’, Divided Bets: Foreigners and Institutions Used Leverage, Individuals Fought Back With Inverse Funds [Why the Stock Market]
summary: The KOSPI rose 17.91% in one session, its largest daily gain on record. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix surged to record levels, while retail investors chose divergent positions, including inverse funds.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, heavily weighted toward Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, two major memory chipmakers.
